diagnosis: Customer is questioning the total of their first invoice after upgrading to the Business plan on the 14th. This appears to be a mid-cycle proration issue.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. When an account upgrades mid-billing cycle, we prorate the remaining days on the previous plan and issue a combined invoice. This results in a proration line appearing as a credit followed by a charge for the new plan, which means the total may differ from the standard plan list price for the first invoice only. For more details, please see our article: Understanding mid-cycle proration on plan upgrades.
